guide.summary: A round sediment meadow ringed with mesh, in open water under a day and night cycle.
guide.biology: A meadow of soft sediment collects dead material that grazers and decomposers live on, while the water around it stays open.
guide.rules: Water with a sediment circle of radius 16 at (64,64); no stones. Attachment mesh on every cell of the circle's edge (the sediment cells that touch water). In the sediment: 0.10 debris carbon with 0.010 bound nutrient. Everywhere: light 0.8, warmth 0.5, oxygen 0.8, carbon dioxide 0.5, nutrient 0.15 and sugar 0.02. Lid open; light cycles between day and night.
guide.example: Watch whether grazers placed in the water reach the meadow.
